additional_source_anchors.contract: Source-time/tag/index sorted events; armed stop strictly before source or E same-main/parent proof; direct S-red armed-blue later decision promotion uses S decision, no strict stop or B-mode gate.
Live StopAll prefix replay with repr and dirty/covered-until gates; settled own stop before dirty may be reused, retained unresolved rescans from max(decision,dirty). No runtime proof.
Filter initial A ledger causes, inherited plus invalid leg-head blocked First; remove accepted initial First; E-only exact stop/First exceptions, not global unblock.

Consumed S evidence requires unaccepted candidate A/source, owner stop before A source, rank higher and strict Close extension. Retain earliest candidate per owner; E handles continuation replacement.
LC40 timed/callback selection uses truthiness, computes S grouping then StopAll, publishes source-time number reset mapping; returns E list copy and StopAll without retroactive E detect.
Final visibility removes E at StopAll source indexes, runs S visibility, restores historical S/A lineage then applies final occupied-index and invalid S identity filters; no second lineage pass.
